segments.text: Greetings and welcome back to the third week
of the MOC introduction to Biarisk Management.
segments.zh: 慕课“生物风险管理导论”的第三周。

segments.text: In this lecture module,
I will introduce you to the concept of the controls,
segments.zh: 我将向大家介绍控制措施的概念，

segments.text: as well as the hierarchy of controls.
And I will describe the manner
in which the controls can be applied concurrently
segments.zh: 同时运用这些控制措施，

segments.text: to mitigate or reduce the risk of exposure
segments.zh: 以缓解或降低实验室操作过程中

segments.text: to the biological agent during laboratory operations.
The extensive description of each of these controls
segments.zh: 每一种控制措施的详细介绍

segments.text: will be discussed in the lectures which follow
during this current week.
These are your learning objectives.
The first learning objective is to introduce you
segments.zh: 第一个学习目标是向大家介绍

segments.text: to the concept of the control or the biarisk control.
segments.zh: 控制措施，即生物风险控制措施的概念。

segments.text: The second objective is the hierarchy of the controls.
segments.zh: 第二个目标是控制措施的层级。

segments.text: And the third is to give you a brief overview
of each of the controls.
segments.zh: 简要概述每一种控制措施。

segments.text: What you should be able to do upon completion
segments.zh: 完成本模块后你应当能够做到：

segments.text: of this module, describe the concept of the control,
describe the five controls and the hierarchy,
segments.zh: 描述五种控制措施及其层级，

segments.text: and identify situations in which controls
can be applied concurrently.
This is the specific definition for biarisk controls,
segments.zh: 这是生物风险控制措施的具体定义，

segments.text: which has been adapted from ISO IEC guide.
Actions implementing biarisk management decisions
segments.zh: 落实生物风险管理决策的各项行动

segments.text: are termed as biarisk controls.
segments.zh: 称为生物风险控制措施。

segments.text: Let us look back briefly on this description of the flow.
segments.zh: 我们简要回顾一下这个流程的说明。

segments.text: So we commence with hazard identification.
We identify the hazards.
We then conduct a risk assessment
and categorize our biological agent
into the respective risk group.
We also conduct a risk assessment using a risk matrix
segments.zh: 我们还会像前面讨论过的那样，

segments.text: as was discussed earlier.
segments.zh: 用风险矩阵进行风险评估。

segments.text: We then move on to risk mitigation
and this is where the controls come into the picture.
segments.zh: 这时控制措施就出现了。

segments.text: Finally, we have what is known as residual risk.
segments.zh: 最后是所谓的剩余风险。

segments.text: And it is at this point that you make this decision,
segments.zh: 在这个阶段你要做出决定：

segments.text: should I proceed with the laboratory procedure
segments.zh: 我是否应该继续这项实验室操作，

segments.text: or should I not proceed?
So if the residual risk is too high
or not acceptable,
you do not continue with this particular procedure.
If it's acceptable, you may continue with the procedure.
segments.zh: 如果可以接受，就可以继续这项操作。

segments.text: We will look at the five controls and the hierarchy
segments.zh: 我们来看五种控制措施及其层级，

segments.text: and I will describe these controls in detail.
segments.zh: 我会详细介绍这些控制措施。

segments.text: The five controls are elimination,
substitution, engineering controls,
administrative controls,
and personal protective equipment.
Personal protective equipment
provide the last line of defense
against the biological agent.
This is why they are placed right
segments.zh: 这就是为什么它被放在

segments.text: at the bottom of this hierarchy.
I will describe each of these controls in detail.
segments.zh: 我会详细介绍每一种控制措施。

segments.text: The first one is elimination.
Let us look at this situation.
segments.zh: 我们来看这样一种情形。

segments.text: Your laboratory has been ordered to test samples
segments.zh: 你们的实验室接到命令，要检测

segments.text: which are likely to belong to risk group four.
segments.zh: 可能属于危险度4级的样本。

segments.text: This may happen in a situation such as a pandemic
segments.zh: 这种情况可能发生在大流行等形势下，

segments.text: in which you are ordered to test pathogens
segments.zh: 你们被要求检测属于高危险度等级，

segments.text: or biological agents which belong to a high risk group,
which is risk group four.
However, your laboratory is not equipped
with directional airflow.
You do not have a containment facility.
The staff do not have adequate training
segments.zh: 工作人员没有接受充分的培训，

segments.text: and SOPs for waste decontamination
and disposal do not exist.
segments.zh: 和处置的标准操作规程。

segments.text: So you have multiple limitations.
segments.zh: 所以你们存在多方面的局限。

segments.text: In this case, it is highly likely
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，极有可能

segments.text: that there will be a breach of containment.
And this is when we resort to elimination.
segments.zh: 这时我们就要采取消除措施。

segments.text: We make a collective decision not to proceed
with the laboratory procedure.
segments.zh: 不开展这项实验室操作。

segments.text: The next control is substitution.
segments.zh: 下一种控制措施是替代。

segments.text: Let us look at another situation.
Your laboratory has been ordered to test samples
segments.zh: 你们的实验室接到命令，要检测

segments.text: which are likely to belong to risk group four.
segments.zh: 可能属于危险度4级的样本。

segments.text: This is the same situation as the first one.
However, the samples will be inactivated
segments.zh: 不过，这些样本在送达你们实验室之前

segments.text: prior to arrival in your laboratory,
which means that they will be no longer viable
segments.zh: 也就是说它们不再具有活性，

segments.text: and incapable of infecting laboratory workers.
segments.zh: 不可能感染实验室工作人员。

segments.text: Your laboratory is equipped with the essential equipment,
segments.zh: 你们的实验室配备了必要的设备，

segments.text: which is a biological safety cabinet.
And the staff are competent and have conducted work
segments.zh: 工作人员胜任这项工作，

segments.text: with biological agents categorized
as risk group four previously.
segments.zh: 划为危险度4级的生物因子。

segments.text: Now, all of these factors add to the adequacy
segments.zh: 所有这些因素都增强了

segments.text: of your controls.
segments.zh: 你们控制措施的充分性。

segments.text: And in this case, you may proceed
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，你们可以

segments.text: with the laboratory procedure with caution.
segments.zh: 谨慎地开展这项实验室操作。

segments.text: This is a case of substitution.
So the very fact that the sample was inactivated
segments.zh: 样本被灭活这一事实本身

segments.text: reduced the likelihood of exposure
segments.zh: 就降低了接触生物因子的

segments.text: to the biological agent
and the subsequent consequences as well.
segments.zh: 也降低了随之而来的后果。

segments.text: The third control, which we will look at
segments.zh: 我们要看的第三种控制措施

segments.text: is the engineering control.
And in order to understand engineering controls,
you need to have a basic understanding
segments.zh: 你需要对自己实验室的布局

segments.text: of the layout of your respective laboratory.
This is a conceptual laboratory,
segments.zh: 这是一个概念性的实验室，

segments.text: which is an enclosed space.
It's just a physical enclosure.
segments.zh: 只是一个实体围护结构。

segments.text: Now, let us say that your management decides
segments.zh: 假设你们的管理层决定

segments.text: to upgrade this to a BSL-2 or a BSL-3 laboratory.
The first thing that you need to look at
is the effluent disposal system,
which is responsible for the disposal
of all the wastes and liquids
coming out from your facility.
Then you look at the HEPA filtration system.
segments.zh: 然后你要考虑HEPA过滤系统。

segments.text: Now, this also adds to your facility
segments.zh: 这也会扩大你们的设施，

segments.text: as you will have to develop
or design two additional floors,
which is to house the HEPA air filtration system
segments.zh: 用来安置HEPA空气过滤系统

segments.text: and your effluent disposal system.
So a lab basically gets converted
segments.zh: 所以一个实验室基本上就变成了

segments.text: into a three-story facility.
Then you have your biological safety cabinet,
which is an essential equipment.
This biological agent must be hard ducted
segments.zh: 这台生物安全柜必须硬管连接

segments.text: into the HEPA filtration system
and the exhaust released into the environment
after filtration.
You can now bring in your personnel
and your animals in this facility,
your experimental animals,
and your directional airflow is set into place
segments.zh: 定向气流也已经布置到位，

segments.text: as well as the effluent disposal system.
segments.zh: 污水处理系统也已就位。

segments.text: So you have directional airflow,
air which enters the facility is filtered
segments.zh: 进入设施的空气经过过滤，

segments.text: and the pressure within this facility is negative
segments.zh: 设施内的压力相对于外部环境

segments.text: with reference to the external environment.
This ensures that there is always a flow of air
into the facility and all the air
which exits the facility is basically filtered.
segments.zh: 排出设施的空气基本上都经过了过滤。

segments.text: This represents a containment zone,
segments.zh: 这就构成了一个防护区，

segments.text: which offers secondary containment.
However, your personnel must also ensure
segments.zh: 不过，你们的人员还必须确保

segments.text: that they don't proper protective equipment
or personal protective equipment
in order to work in this facility.
segments.zh: 才能在这个设施中工作。

segments.text: So this is a brief description of the engineering control.
segments.zh: 以上就是工程控制措施的简要介绍。

segments.text: I will discuss the engineering control in detail
in a subsequent lecture.
segments.zh: 详细讨论工程控制措施。

segments.text: The engineering design is basically governed
segments.zh: 工程设计基本上取决于

segments.text: by the facility design itself.
This is where engineers come in.
Then you have your directional airflow,
your filtration systems,
your heating ventilation and air conditioning system,
the effluent disposal system,
the plumbing systems,
the intelligent controls,
which may involve computers and other devices
segments.zh: 这可能涉及把你们实验室接入网络的

segments.text: which link your laboratory to the network
and which you can monitor and control
from a remote hosting station,
as well as the security systems
which are responsible for the management
of biosecurity at your respective facility.
segments.zh: 你们各自设施的生物安保。

segments.text: We now move on to administrative controls.
segments.zh: 下面我们来看管理控制措施。

segments.text: So the administrative controls
basically comprise the policies
as well as the laboratory virus management system.
segments.zh: 以及实验室生物风险管理体系。

segments.text: We have our policies,
roles and responsibilities
segments.zh: 实验室生物风险管理手册中规定的

segments.text: as defined in the laboratory virus management manual.
The standard operating procedures,
these are very important
and we will be discussing these in detail
in a separate lecture.
Contingency plans which address emergencies,
segments.zh: 应对紧急情况的应急计划、

segments.text: vaccination of personnel,
training of personnel
and audits which form part of your performance assessment.
segments.zh: 以及构成绩效评估一部分的审核。

segments.text: We now move on to the fifth control
segments.zh: 下面我们来看第五种控制措施，

segments.text: which is the last line of defense
against the biological agent
and this is personal protective equipment.
These include gloves,
different kinds of gloves
segments.zh: 根据实验室操作的类型

segments.text: based on the type of the laboratory procedure.
For example, when working with animals,
you may have to wear special gloves
segments.zh: 你可能需要戴特殊的手套，

segments.text: which prevent bites and scratches.
Masks, respirators.
Respirators are masks
which are fitted with motorized HEPA filters.
segments.zh: 装有电动HEPA过滤器的面罩。

segments.text: I will discuss this in detail
and provide you with a demonstration of a respirator.
segments.zh: 并为大家演示呼吸器的使用。

segments.text: Protective gowns which protect your skin
segments.zh: 防护服可以保护你的皮肤，

segments.text: from cutaneous infection via the skin
which may be in the form of spills.
segments.zh: 经皮肤造成的皮肤感染。

segments.text: Protective glasses which protect your eyes
segments.zh: 防护眼镜可以保护你的眼睛，

segments.text: from viruses which may enter through the ocular route.
segments.zh: 防止病毒经眼部途径进入。

segments.text: So these are some of the personal protective equipment
segments.zh: 这些就是一些个人防护装备，

segments.text: which I will discuss in a subsequent lecture.
segments.zh: 我会在后面的一讲中讨论。

segments.text: Finally, we move on to the concurrent usage of controls.
segments.zh: 最后，我们来看控制措施的同时运用。

segments.text: So controls are used concurrently.
segments.zh: 控制措施是同时使用的。

segments.text: For instance, your personal protective equipment
segments.zh: 例如，你的个人防护装备

segments.text: must be used concurrently
segments.zh: 必须与穿脱个人防护装备的

segments.text: with the standard operating procedure
for donning and doffing of the PPE.
So the SOP is essentially an administrative control.
segments.zh: 而标准操作规程本质上属于管理控制措施。

segments.text: Entry and exit into the laboratory is governed by an SOP.
segments.zh: 进出实验室由标准操作规程来规范。

segments.text: The laboratory in itself is an engineering control.
segments.zh: 实验室本身是一项工程控制措施。

segments.text: However, the entry and exit is governed
by an administrative control.
The SOP for the operation of the entire facility itself
segments.zh: 整个设施运行的标准操作规程

segments.text: is governed by more than one control.
segments.zh: 受不止一种控制措施的约束。

segments.text: This is how the controls are used concurrently.
segments.zh: 这就是控制措施同时使用的方式。

segments.text: So you may have administrative controls,
segments.zh: 所以可能存在管理控制措施、

segments.text: engineering controls and the PPEs
segments.zh: 工程控制措施和个人防护装备

segments.text: all overlapping with each other.
And this is the way in which we manage
segments.zh: 这就是我们在特定防护设施中

segments.text: the bi-risk management system
segments.zh: 管理生物风险管理体系的

segments.text: in a specific containment facility.
This brings us to the end of this introductory module
segments.zh: 关于风险缓解的这个入门模块

segments.text: on risk mitigation.
We have learned about the five controls.
segments.zh: 我们学习了五种控制措施。

segments.text: We have learned about the hierarchy of controls,
segments.zh: 我们学习了控制措施的层级、

segments.text: the concept of residual risk,
as well as the concurrent usage of controls.
segments.zh: 以及控制措施的同时运用。

segments.text: I will delve into each of these controls
in a series of lectures during this current week.
segments.zh: 系列讲座中深入讲解每一种控制措施。

segments.text: Thank you very much for your participation
in this lecture module.
And I wish you a pleasant learning experience.
Thank you and stay bio safe.
